name: cognee-memory
description: Cognee knowledge graph memory for Claude Code — session-aware storage, auto-routing recall, and persistent learning across sessions. Supports local mode and Cognee Cloud.

icon.title: Cognee mark
icon.description: The cognee mark: the waveform icon on the status row and the credit line in the Desktop app (the official SVG), and the display logotype on the credit line in a terminal. none turns both off.

band.title: Status row above the prompt
band.description: Draw the Cognee status row above the prompt, in the Desktop app and in a terminal: the badge, the dataset name as a picker, the counters and what memory is doing. Off, no row is drawn (add the plugin's statusLine entry to your settings yourself for a line below the prompt).

spinner.title: Spinner activity
spinner.description: Add what Cognee is doing (recalling, saving, consolidating) after the spinner while Claude works.

tools.title: Memory tools for Claude
tools.description: Register search and remember as tools Claude can call directly (mcp__cognee-memory__search / remember) instead of going through a skill and a shell command.

tour.title: First-run tour
tour.description: On the first session on this machine, show three short hints under the status row about what it shows and does (/cognee-tour replays them).
